What We Procure

Procurement Categories

ATLINE actively sources suppliers across these ICT infrastructure categories.

Network Infrastructure

Structured cabling, fibre optic, copper, patch panels and trunking systems.

Active Network Devices

Switches, routers, firewalls, access points and network controllers.

ICT Hardware & Equipment

Computers, laptops, servers, storage systems and peripheral devices.

IP Surveillance Systems

IP cameras, NVRs, DVRs, access control and intercom systems.

Installation Materials

Cable trays, conduits, racks, cabinets and supporting hardware.

General ICT Supplies

Consumables, accessories, connectors, tools and miscellaneous ICT items.

Supplier Journey

How the Registration Process Works

A streamlined four-step process from registration to receiving your first purchase order.

01

Register as Supplier

Complete the online Supplier Registration Form with your company details, compliance documents and service categories.

02

Application Review

Our procurement team evaluates your submission for completeness, compliance status and capability alignment.

03

Approval & On-boarding

Approved suppliers receive a welcome notice and are added to the ATLINE Approved Vendor List (AVL).

04

Receive RFQs & POs

Approved vendors are invited to quote for relevant procurement exercises and awarded purchase orders directly.

Ready to start? Registration takes approximately 10–15 minutes.

What You Need

Registration Requirements

Ensure you have the following documents and information ready before you begin your supplier registration.

Valid SSM / ROB / ROC registration
Company profile and business overview
MOF / CIDB certification (where applicable)
Bank account details for payment processing
Director / proprietor identification details
Latest financial statements or bank statement
Why Register

Benefits of Being an ATLINE Supplier

Direct Procurement Access

Receive RFQs and tender invitations directly from ATLINE's procurement team for matching categories.

Timely Payment Terms

Structured payment milestones and clear terms ensure timely settlement upon delivery and acceptance.

Long-term Partnership

Build a sustained business relationship with ATLINE through repeat engagements and framework agreements.

Business Growth Opportunity

Access government and private sector projects through ATLINE's established project pipeline across Malaysia.
